notes: Counts are rendered geometry records. Clipped ways can have several fragments; connected same-type road, water and power segments form whole selectable networks with branches, retaining all source IDs. Navigation keeps the original roads.

Every building has a gameplay purpose and category color. Explicit mapped tags and contained POIs remain distinguishable from context or fictional game assignments; raw building geometry/tags remain unchanged.

Crossings, traffic signs, barriers, aircraft parking marks and point electrical equipment are retained in raw data but omitted from the game presentation. Administrative boundaries are hidden. Railway lines belong to roads; physical airport/apron surfaces remain objects.

Only natural landscape biomes and an unzoned-ground fallback remain in the landscape registry. Ordinary urban/service zone fills, building footprint zone facets, density fillers and plot-fusion strips are retired from game presentation; source grounds remain evidence for building roles.
Categories partition the details layer exactly. Source tags and IDs are retained for every record.
